event.description:
Welcome to the NorCal Regional for Grand Archive hosted by Final Cut TCG!
Streaming will be by TM32 plus locals!

Location:

Santa Clara Convention Center (Great America Meeting Rooms 2nd Floor)

5001 Great America Pkwy,

Santa Clara, CA 95054

Date: September 21st Saturday

Start Time For Round 1: 10:00am

Registration: $35 Through FinalCutTCG.com Search Grand Archive NorCal Regionals Ticket 

Check in Time: 8:00am-9:50am(please submit your deck list through Omnidex and check in with registration during this time)

Entry Prizing:
*First 64 tickets purchased come with: 1 Silver Pack, 1 Sapphire Pack, 1 Regionals Challenger Playmat+Proxia Vault Pack*
ALL competitors receive 1 Final Cut TCG NorCal Regionals Imbue Token + 1 NorCal Regionals Entry Badge!

Format:

Swiss Rounds based on attendance.

Top 16 Prizing! 1 day event with no top cut.

Top 8 receive invites!

1st- 1 box of MRC, Champion Mat, Finalist Mat, Nationals Invite Card(Regional) 6 Gold Packs, 2 Silver Packs
